title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2605.18421v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent benchmarks for Large Language Model (LLM) agents mainly evaluate reasoning, planning, and execution. However, memory is also essential for agents, as it enables them to store, update, and retrieve information over time. This ability remains under-evaluated, largely because existing benchmarks do not provide a systematic way to assess memory mechanisms. In this paper, we study agent memory from a self-evolving perspective and introduce EvoMemBench, a unified benchmark organized along two axes: memory scope (in-episode vs. cross-episode) and memory content (knowledge-oriented vs. execution-oriented). We compare 15 representative memory methods with strong long-context baselines under a standardized protocol. translated_title: EvoMemBench：从自我进化视角评估智能体记忆能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.18421v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期针对大语言模型（LLM）智能体的基准测试主要评估推理、规划和执行能力。然而，记忆对智能体同样至关重要，因为它使智能体能够随时间推移存储、更新和检索信息。由于现有基准测试缺乏系统评估记忆机制的方法，这一能力至今未被充分评估。本文从自我进化的视角研究智能体记忆，并提出了EvoMemBench——一个沿两个维度组织的统一基准：记忆范围（回合内 vs. 跨回合）和记忆内容（面向知识 vs. 面向执行）。我们在标准化协议下将15种代表性记忆方法与强大的长上下文基线进行了比较。结果表明，当前的记忆系统仍远未达到通用解决方案的水平：长上下文基线依然极具竞争力；记忆在当前上下文不足或任务困难时最有帮助；且没有任何单一方法能够……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个从自我进化视角出发、沿记忆范围与记忆内容两个维度系统评估LLM智能体记忆能力的统一基准EvoMemBench，并通过对比15种记忆方法与长上下文基线，揭示出当前记忆系统尚无通用解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EvoMemBench, a unified benchmark that systematically evaluates LLM agent memory from a self-evolving perspective along two axes—memory scope and memory content—and reveals through comparisons of 15 memory methods against long-context baselines that current memory systems are still far from a general solution.
